item.title: Denver's historic 1907 bank building sits empty despite a $22.4 million renovation
item.description: Denver’s historic Vault building, bought for $17.6 million in 2017, remains completely vacant despite a $22.4 million renovation. The 107,630-square-foot former bank building once housed WeWork, which left in 2021. With downtown office vacancies still high, the 119-year-old property is now being offered for office use, adaptive reuse, residential conversion or hospitality.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Scientists tracked 21 oilbirds in Venezuela, and five of them left their cave for up to 73 days
item.description: Oilbirds display distinct travel patterns when seeking fruit in tropical forests. Some birds return to their main cave nightly, while others venture out for days. A third group undertakes longer trips, staying away for weeks near feeding grounds. These migratory oilbirds flew less each night, conserving energy by resting closer to food. Researchers tracked twenty-one birds using devices to record their movements and flight times.

item.title: 84-year-old Wyoming Navy veteran donates 207-acre llama ranch as sanctuary for veterans and first responders
item.description: In an inspiring act of philanthropy, Navy veteran Al Ellis has gifted his expansive ranch in Wyoming to a dedicated foundation. This sanctuary will cater to veterans and first responders, providing a serene environment for healing and family bonding. With the Boulder Crest Foundation’s specialized initiatives, the campus is anticipated to be operational by September 2027, transforming lives one family at a time.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Joe Thomas' Farm Journey: ex-Browns star builds Hall of Fame cattle business; Wagyu drives growth
item.description: After hanging up his football jersey in 2018, former NFL star Joe Thomas took a new path in life as a cattle farmer in Wisconsin. His venture, Hall of Fame Farms, has flourished, now specializing in high-quality Wagyu and Certified Angus beef. With the same discipline that led him on the field, Thomas expertly navigates his agricultural journey, illustrating the power of perseverance in a completely different arena.

item.title: Pakistan airstrikes on Afghanistan: 3 killed, several injured as conflict fears grow
item.description: Pakistan and Afghanistan were involved in their most serious military confrontation in years in February. The latest escalation comes days after the Taliban warned that it would defend Afghan territory against any Pakistani military action. In an interview with Al Arabiya English, Mujahid rejected Pakistan's allegations that militant groups based in Afghanistan recruit, train and launch attacks against Pakistan.

item.title: US, China launch 'AI dialogue' ahead of Trump-Xi summit amid race to control AI risks
item.description: US treasury secretary Scott Bessent announced the agreement after talks with Chinese vice-premier He Lifeng in New York on Sunday. The two sides also moved ahead with plans for a trade mechanism first discussed when Trump met Xi in Beijing. The agreement comes as technology leaders warn that rapid advances in AI could create serious risks if research continues without adequate safeguards.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: Pokimane Pushes Back On Fans: Twitch star slams intrusive family questions; opens up about therapy
item.description: Pokimane called out viewers for asking when she plans to have children, describing such questions as invasive and disrespectful. She challenged societal expectations placed on women regarding marriage and motherhood while discussing fertility. During the same livestream, the Twitch star revealed she is seeing two therapists as part of her long-term mental health journey. She said she has been going through a difficult period but feels supported and is prioritising her well-being.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Putin-backed United Russia leads Duma polls at 57.5% as Ukraine war looms
item.description: The three-day parliamentary election ended on Sunday, with the final results expected by September 25. Early figures released by Russia's Central Election Commission showed United Russia well ahead of other parties. The election is the first parliamentary vote since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. United Russia won 324 of the 450 seats in the State Duma in the previous parliamentary election in 2021.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Crocodile tears': Iran shuts French language centre, slams France over Mahsa Amini
item.description: Iranian authorities accused the centre of operating for years without the required licence and said it had gone beyond language teaching. They alleged that it was involved in activities they considered harmful to Iranian culture and national security, including identifying and building networks and helping skilled Iranians leave the country.

Iran warns US, allies against new attack, threatens retaliation
item.description: Iran has reiterated its commitment to retaliate against the United States and its allies for any major offensive, citing credible intelligence indicating such actions are imminent. In response, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Tehran about potential severe repercussions. The recent violence, including attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi sites, has aggravated tensions and disrupted regional energy supplies and maritime operations.

item.title: A NJ family has owned a 135-acre Christmas tree farm for 80 years; the preserved property...
item.description: On the market is a remarkable 135-acre Christmas tree farm in Warren County, New Jersey, a family-owned gem for eighty years. This unique estate features a stunning 1839 timber-frame barn and a charming guest cottage. With farmland preservation in place, buyers can ensure this agricultural haven remains untouched by urban growth, and the sale includes necessary equipment and established customer pathways.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, eighth-grader who is competing for $100,000 in STEM awards
item.description: An eighth-grade student from Pennsylvania, Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, has become a national finalist for her groundbreaking GERD drug delivery system. She created an innovative controlled release mechanism aimed at prolonging the effectiveness of antacid medications. This recognition follows her success at regional science fairs, and she will vie for educational accolades in Washington, D.C. in October, showcasing her dedication to improving heartburn treatment outcomes.
